nina (partner-eng): Quick sync request — before we flip the marketplace listing live we need a gating checklist for schema drift and vector mapping. Concern: customers ingesting via Delta Sharing may change column types and break connector deserialization. cc @kevin @jia

kevin (eng-platform): Agree. Propose automated smoke: ingest sample delta-share table, run schema-hash, then apply schema-change mutation and assert connector rejects with clear error + telemetry event. Keep tests in staging only.

jia (eng-ml): Also check embeddings pipeline: if vector dim changes (e.g., 768->1024) we must surface mismatch before writing to DB. We'll add an evaluator that validates embedding dims and cosine sanity.

tom (partner-ops): I'll coordinate with Snowflake and Databricks PMs. Need partner sandbox creds and a sample Delta Share with 500 rows.

rhea (legal): Reminder: any staging data must be synthetic or consented. No customer PII in samples. Add data handling note to partner comms.

ci-bot: CI pipeline: delta-share-smoke #452 triggered by kevin — running ingestion tests (status: running)

nina (partner-eng): Minimal checklist draft:
- sandbox share + creds procured
- synthetic sample datasets (no PII)
- schema-hash baseline + change mutation
- vector-dim validator
- telemetry: schema_change.alert + vector_mismatch.metric
- rollback plan and marketplace gating flag

kevin (eng-platform): Test scripts (staging) — sample to compute schema hash:
```sql
-- compute simple schema fingerprint
SELECT MD5(CONCAT_WS('|', ARRAY_AGG(column_name || ':' || data_type ORDER BY column_name))) AS schema_hash
FROM information_schema.columns
WHERE table_schema = 'share_schema' AND table_name = 'sample_table';
```

jia (eng-ml): Embedding check (python snippet):
```python
if embeddings.shape[1] != EXPECTED_DIM:
  emit('vector_mismatch', {'expected': EXPECTED_DIM, 'actual': embeddings.shape[1]})
  raise ValueError('embedding dimension mismatch')
```

tom (partner-ops): I'll draft partner-facing note: "we'll perform non-destructive schema & vector resilience tests in staging on DATE between HH:MM-HH:MM UTC. Please provide sandbox share and contact." Will post to partner channel tomorrow.

rhea (legal): Add sentence: "Do not include any customer-identifiable information in test shares. See legal playbook: link." :warning:

ci-bot: delta-share-smoke #452 status: success (run time 4m 12s) :white_check_mark:

nina (partner-eng): Great — results look clean. Owners & next steps:
- tom: collect sandbox creds (by Wed)
- kevin: add schema-hash smoke to preflight (by Wed EOD)
- jia: embed validator + metric (by Thu)
- rhea: approve partner note language (by Wed)

kevin (eng-platform): Will add gating flag in marketplace deploy pipeline to block listing if smoke fails.

nina (partner-eng): Thanks everyone. This gating should reduce hotfixes post-announcement. We'll re-run before go-live. :rocket:
